findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "quote_shipment" is 1080 chars, far longer than this server's median (145). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "quote_shipment" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
